title: anthemis bornmuelleri var. galilaea
intro: Anthemis bornmuelleri var. galilaea, commonly known as Galilee chamomile, is a variety of the Anthemis bornmuelleri plant, belonging to the Asteraceae family. This herb is known for its calming and soothing properties, which make it beneficial for health issues such as insomnia, anxiety, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Galilee chamomile include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties, which help to reduce inflammation, soothe muscle spasms, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Anthemis bornmuelleri var. galilaea include flavonoids, terpenoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and health benefits.
